experiment: WBCAtt+ and BCCD only, camera-background repair, RGB160 15Hz single-cell FPGA
excluded_source: No Raabin image or Raabin-trained initialization. Previous Raabin+BCCD model is preserved for rollback/comparison only.
initialization: WBCAtt-only seed20261021 FP32 checkpoint; its original initialization was random, warmstart=None
split: Keep existing author WBCAtt and frozen BCCD scene splits; all derived crops follow parents; audit decoded/raw and actual RGB160 duplicates across the two sources before training
duplicates: Exact cross-split duplicates exclude lower priority entire parent group, TEST > VAL > TRAIN; within same split prefer original positive over derived negative; conflicting typed labels excluded. No performance-based exclusions.
BCCD_labels: WBC box/objectness only; five-class labels remain -1 and class loss is masked
mosaic: Only typed WBCAtt positive slots, 30%; never replaces negative/BCCD slots
augmentation: Standard flip/scale/color; restrained camera panel/exposure/blur/noise; procedural flat/gradient/rectangular/noise backgrounds are augmentation, not a third acquired dataset
negative_loss: Base objectness loss plus 0.5*softplus(top20 objectness logits) on wholly negative images, to avoid diluting a few high-confidence false boxes over 300 anchors
checkpoint_selection: VAL only, fixed monitoring threshold 0.70: 0.7 WBCAtt joint macro-F1 + 0.3 BCCD localization F1 - 0.3 procedural VAL image-FP rate - 0.1 acquired-negative image-FP rate
final_threshold: Freeze weights, then VAL-only grid 0.40..0.95 step0.025 with the same balanced objective; must satisfy VAL recall/precision/negative criteria. No TEST or user screenshot threshold tuning.

gate.RTL_and_hardware: Exact integer vectors including all five classes and empty inputs; full720p schedule; all regression sources matched; final setup/hold>=0; source/model/bit hashes match; TD6.2 chip PH1P35MDG324

test_policy: WBCAtt and BCCD TEST have already been examined in previous experiments; evaluate selected frozen model only as reused regression. Never claim a new untouched test or use TEST to select weights/thresholds.
camera_probes: User screenshots contain OSD, not raw clean RGB; historical cell type unknown. Development checks are not camera accuracy measurement.
runtime: All detection/classification/background rejection/tracking/overlay in FPGA; unchanged 15Hz, single cell box, English full names; original .al only; SRAM only
